message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause is in the vendored `slugify` (`vendor/slugify/index.js`). It deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters vanish. `vendor/` is off-limits, so I left it alone. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`, where `postSlug` now strips accents before calling `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored `slugify`, so shop URLs still drop accented letters. I didn't touch it, since you only asked about blog posts. If you want it fixed, the platform team could upgrade the library, or I could apply the same workaround there.
